pages.text: The $(item)high-voltage bus duct$() carries 524,288 FE/t with no loss. It is the only thick block cable and it is for high voltage only: it joins generators, power plants, $(item)transformers$(), other ducts and high-voltage insulators. Ordinary cables, machines and cells do not attach: high voltage only runs from a generator to a transformer.

To power machines, run the duct into a $(item)transformer$() (side, back or bottom) and put an ordinary energy cable at the transformer's front: the transformer gives it exactly what it carries.$(br2)$(4)Overload:$() an ordinary cable burns out when more than 10,000 FE is pushed into it in one tick (a huge generator or a high-voltage insulator).
